role: Inactive AUTHOR candidate only; independent scope review required
basis: The current SekII scopes explicitly retain both existing SekI laboratory/safety atomics as prerequisiteOnly but omit their existing canonical parent. Several retained foundational goals directly require that parent. Add only that exact interface, preserve the complete current target set and all prior support IDs. No new subject duty, prerequisite removal, card, canonical body, or assumed mastery is created.
